templates.manifest_eye_smile_v3: EDIT/extract ONLY the requested eye-layer component. Image1 is the selected mannequin used ONLY for the fixed rig placement; do NOT copy its lit eyelids or skin. Image2 is the black/white region GUIDE reference (not a dedicated mask API). Image3 is the approved matte poster-paint style reference. Retain the ENTIRE upright 768x1024 canvas, facial center x384, eye line y360, shoulder line y700, unchanged eye sockets and full outline, no crop, no zoom or recenter. Output only the isolated component over uniform #FF00FF across the full canvas. ALL non-component pixels are pure #FF00FF. Remove every head, face, eyelid skin, backing patch, eyebrow, nose, neck, clothing, rectangular panel, guide and text. No scene or complete person. Make exactly TWO THIN upward-bowed CLOSED smiling lash arcs at the original paired eye positions, with a few sparse fine dark outer eyelashes. The crest of each closed-eye arc sits above its ends, giving an unmistakable happy closed-eye smile. There are NO eyeballs, sclera, irises or pupils. Paint ONLY the fine lash STROKES, approximately2to3canvas pixels thick: no crescent-shaped filled ribbon, no painted eyelid volume, no filled space above/below/between the lash strokes. Use near-flat DEEP CHARCOAL matte brush pigment, approximately #2C3032, with subtle irregular hand-painted edges in the same DARK range. This tiny lash component has NO lighting or reflective shading: override any mannequin/style lighting and use NO highlights, NO pale upper strip, NO white/gray/silver band, NO second contour above the lash, NO glow or metallic/beveled look. Do not draw a thick two-tone arc. Only thin deep charcoal strokes on magenta; brush texture must never form a bright rim.
templates.manifest_eye_sad_v3: EDIT/extract ONLY the requested eye-layer component. Image1 is the selected mannequin used ONLY for the fixed rig placement; do NOT copy its lit eyelids or skin. Do not copy the mannequin's lit upper eyelid. Matte hand-painted poster-paint eye cores, not plastic or metallic; every pixel outside the actual eye/lash contour is pure magenta.
